summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as router between lan-a (node2, 10.50.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, 10.50.20.0/24). Assigned static addressing on node2/node3 eth1 and node1 eth1/eth2, added cross-LAN static routes on node2/node3, and applied a VyOS forward-filter firewall on node1: default-action drop, rule 5 accepts established/related, rule 10 accepts only TCP/5432 from lan-a to lan-b. Verified TCP/5432 succeeds while all other traffic (TCP/22, ICMP) between the LANs is dropped, both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time with boot-identity proof of each restart and post-restart functional re-verification.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 eth0/eth1/eth2 (VyOS), node2 eth0/eth1, node3 eth0/eth1 on AlmaLinux 9
Assigned static IP 10.50.10.11/24 to node2 eth1 via nmcli, gateway 10.50.10.254
Assigned static IP 10.50.20.12/24 to node3 eth1 via nmcli, gateway 10.50.20.254
Configured VyOS node1 eth1=10.50.10.254/24, eth2=10.50.20.254/24 and committed/saved
Added cross-LAN static routes on node2 (10.50.20.0/24 via 10.50.10.254) and node3 (10.50.10.0/24 via 10.50.20.254)
Opened 5432/tcp in node3's local firewalld (separate host firewall from the router)
Configured VyOS forward filter: default-action drop, rule 5 established/related accept, rule 10 accept tcp dport 5432 from 10.50.10.0/24 iif eth1 to 10.50.20.0/24 oif eth2; committed and saved
Verified baseline (pre-firewall) connectivity, then post-firewall: 5432 allowed, ssh/22 and ICMP blocked, using a socat listener on node3
Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes, restarted node1 then node2 then node3 one at a time via `reboot`, polled until exec succeeded again, confirmed new boot_id on each

Re-verified post-restart: VyOS interface addresses and firewall ruleset persisted (config.boot save), node2/node3 routes and firewalld rule persisted, and end-to-end 5432-allow/other-block behavior still correct with live packet counters on node1's firewall rules

evidence.requirement: Allow node2 -> node3 TCP/5432, reject all other cross-LAN traffic (functional requirement)
evidence.summary: Baseline showed unrestricted access; VyOS forward-filter firewall committed with default-drop, established/related accept, and a specific accept for tcp/5432 lan-a->lan-b; post-config test shows 5432 succeeds, ssh/22 and ICMP time out/drop, with rule hit counters confirming exact match paths.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d...; reboot issued; exec timed out/reset while down; new boot_id 1d03b17e... confirms restart; post-restart interfaces eth1/eth2 and firewall ruleset intact (config persisted via save), and functional recheck (5432 allow / 22 block) passed.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot issued; connection timed out while down; new boot_id 2b8db6ee... confirms restart; post-restart ip route shows persisted cross-LAN static route and functional recheck (5432 allow / 22 block) passed.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; reboot issued; connection timed out while down; new boot_id c50d16b1... confirms restart; post-restart firewalld port 5432 and static route persisted; final full-chain recheck from node2 shows 5432 succeeds and 22/ICMP blocked, with VyOS rule counters (rule10=3 pkts allowed, default drop=8 pkts) proving the router firewall was live and enforcing across all three restarts.
